text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
A birthday present for me?! I-I don't<n>know what to
say!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
It's a lucky cat statue I got from a<n>really lucky spot
down south. I just<n>hope you don't already have
one like<n>this!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
A lucky spot... down south? Add the<n>distinct ring of
this bell, along with the<n>weight...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
C-could it be? Isn't this the fabled<n>ultra-rare lucky
cat that only a few<n>can ever hope to get their hands
on?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Wow, thank you, thank you, thank<n>you! This is the
best present ever!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
H-hehe... I'm just glad you aren't put<n>off by my
present...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's this? There's a scrap<n>of paper stuck
to the box...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Doto! You forgot to take off the<n>receipt!
